messages:
irene (support): heads up — customer AcmeHealth on Dedicated pool 'pool-7' is seeing sustained 429s during a traffic ramp. says it started ~09:02 UTC.

irene (support): summary from customer: sudden spike when their batch writer kicked off, ~15k requests/min for 3m, clients saw 429 + increased p99 latency. they think reserved capacity should have absorbed it.

rate-limiter-bot: automated alert: 429_RATE_LIMIT - pool=pool-7 qps=1200 cap_effective=1000 burst_allowance=5s

dinesh (sre): can you paste the raw headers they sent? also which model was pinned?

irene (support): pasted from customer logs: 
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer sk-***
X-Redwood-Pool: pool-7
Content-Type: application/json
{"model":"open-15b-dedicated-v1","input":"..."}
```

alex (infra): that model `open-15b-dedicated-v1` has per-instance concurrency 8 and per-pool throughput cap set to 1000 qps in the last config. autoscale policy says burst window 10s, scale-step 2 nodes, cooldown 60s.

maya (product): customer mentioned committed SLA to 1200 qps. are we sure pool config matched the SLA? sounds like config drift or missed reservation.

irene (support): their contract ID: ACME-2025-DED-3. they included an export of /admin/pools/pool-7 which shows committed_qps: 1200 but effective_cap: 1000.

alex (infra): possible mismatch between billing/reservations service and runtime enforcement. runtime reads `cap_effective` from capacity manifest cached per minute. if reservation changed yesterday but manifest not invalidated, enforcement stays lower.

dinesh (sre): repro steps i'm running locally:
```
# sim load (repro)
for i in {1..1600}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Pool: pool-7" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done
```
I see 429s start at ~1000 concurrent. logs: `rate_limiter: exceeded cap 1000 -> 429`.

alex (infra): quick fix: bump effective cap to 1300 on runtime for pool-7 (hot patch) while we reconcile reservations. will need approval from ops due to spillover on shared infra.

maya (product): approve for 1 hour emergency bump if we put hard guard: only allow traffic from contract ACME-2025-DED-3 and enable fallback to lower-cost model if sustained >1500.

sam (billing): note: if we route >committed without invoice update, finance needs to know. will set the overage flag and send notice.

irene (support): customer prefers no throttling, they need the traffic for an internal migration. asked for ETA on fix.

alex (infra): doing hot patch now — updating runtime manifest key `/pools/pool-7/effective_cap` -> 1300.

deploy-bot: deploy started by alex — runtime-manifest/pool-7 update (canary -> global)

dinesh (sre): after patch i'm seeing request success rate back to normal, p95 latency stable. still seeing a few tail 429s from older nodes.

irene (support): relayed to AcmeHealth, they confirm reduced 429s and will monitor.

maya (product): action items: 1) reconcile owned reservation record vs runtime manifest, 2) add manifest invalidation on reservation updates, 3) document emergency bump flow in runbook.

sam (billing): action: create overage line-item for ACME-2025-DED-3 and hold billing until we confirm exact delta.

dinesh (sre): runbook note: recommend adding smoothing policy to reserved pools to avoid short spike caps — example config: 
```
reserved_pools:
  pool-7:
    committed_qps: 1200
    effective_cap: 1200
    smoothing: {window: 30s, max_increase_per_minute: 300}
```

irene (support): filing internal ticket INC-5421 and linking customer's support case #90122. assigning to alex/dinesh for follow-up.

alex (infra): follow-up checks: verify autoscale logs for 09:00-09:10, reconcile manifest publish times, and confirm no token/auth issue masked as 429s.

dinesh (sre): quick note: auth errors we saw in other threads are 401/403, not 429, so not related.

irene (support): thanks everyone. i'll keep customer updated and close loop once INC-5421 has root-cause. :thumbsup:

maya (product): scheduling a 30-min postmortem tomorrow to align on policy changes and product-side alerts for reservation drift.

sam (billing): pinging finance slack to pre-approve emergency overage billing flow.

rate-limiter-bot: note: created ticket RL-870 for quota drift detection rule.

irene (support): closing thread for now — will append postmortem link when ready.
